g.text: Target Slash Command Boundaries and Object Lifetimes
The Controller owns HTTP adaptation only.
It does not load Session state or resolve commands.
One GET or POST owns one immutable catalog.
List, Help, admission, and dispatch share it.
Mutable state is rechecked at the owning lock or transaction.
Raw credentials live only for this request.
They are not logged, persisted, or added to prompts.
